name: synthetic-ui-demo
description: Product demo and release-notes videos with no screen recording. Rebuild the app's screens as static React from its source code, then drive them in Remotion with a scripted cursor and camera (lib/components Stage + Cursor). Use when making a product walkthrough, feature demo, release-notes or changelog video for an app whose source you can read, or when a Playwright recording would be flaky, need test data, or go stale. Triggers include synthetic demo, rebuild the UI, release video, feature walkt
author: digitalsamba
